cards.card_text: Aaron gets a fine linen tunic, a fine linen turban and an embroidered sash, and his sons get tunics, sashes and headbands.
cards.verse_text: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
cards.snippet: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.

cards.card_text: Then come tunics for Aaron's sons, plus sashes and headbands.
cards.verse_text: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them.
cards.snippet: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them.

cards.card_text: Then come the linen pieces: tunics, a turban, ornate headbands, undergarments and a sash embroidered with blue, purple and scarlet yarn.
cards.verse_text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen, and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: Tunics and sashes and headbands Robes and ephods and breastpieces Cloaks and belts and sandals
cards.verse_text: Then Moses presented Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him.
cards.snippet: …Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him.

cards.card_text: In that day, the Lord will take away their finery, and Isaiah lists it out: anklets, headbands, perfume bottles, nose rings, festive robes, purses, mirrors and a whole lot more.
cards.verse_text: In that day the Lord will take away their finery: their anklets and headbands and crescents; their pendants, bracelets, and veils; their headdresses, ankle chains, and sashes; their perfume bottles and charms; their signet rings and nose rings; their festive robes, capes, cloaks, and purses; and their mirrors, linen garments, tiaras, and shawls.
